name: Small Medkit
description: A single-use auto-injector that patches minor wounds and kills surface radiation.

name: Large Medkit
description: A Sacre Base trauma kit. Stops bleeding, closes lacerations, and purges isotopes.

name: Tricorder
description: Pre-war scanning tool. Reveals nearby hostiles and scans salvage for hidden value.

name: Power Pack
description: Standard fission battery. Runs most salvaged weapons and base utilities.

name: Grav Pack
description: Heavy graviton battery. Required to fire siege-class long range weaponry.

name: Vortex Cell
description: Swirling plasma cell favored by Cabal artifacts. Glows faintly blue.

name: Kralox Cell
description: Banned mutant-forged cell. Unstable but massively energetic; used in Kralox tech.

name: Puritron Fragment
description: A mangled shard of the Puritron atmospheric filter. Return it to the Archives.
